definition: PINTIG adaptation: arithmetic mean of two valid measurements in cm, rounded to 0.1 cm. Both required. Refusal/missing/invalid => missing, never a numeric circumference. Clothing stored separately; no clothing correction invented.
encoding: Positive physical measurement; simulation restricted to 65-160 cm (PINTIG assumption, not questionnaire limits)
missing_handling: Preserve missing; no global imputation; current generated responses complete
limitations: PURE measurement instruction manual not supplied; anatomical tape placement and official replicate-combination rule unverified. Mean is a proposed PINTIG adaptation. No actual hip measurements in framingham.csv. Offspring10/Omni5 PDF p73 T01 hip supports another protocol in inches to next lower quarter inch, not substituted here.

definition: Current treatment = 1 for response 1; 0 for responses 0 or 2; missing for 9 or missing/invalid response. Follow-up items are not necessary to encode current use and are not generated; no fabricated medication-start history.

definition: PINTIG-only binary adaptation: 1 if either applicable item is Several Periods of Stress or Permanent Stress; 0 if all applicable items are Never Experienced Stress or Some Period of Stress; otherwise missing. Work not applicable is skipped, not coded as no stress. Home always applicable. Preserve original response strings in sidecar; no questionnaire numeric codes invented.

limitations: Questionnaire provides no validated binary score. Threshold and aggregation are proposed adaptations, not PURE scoring instructions. Financial stress Q36 and depression Q37 are separate constructs and are excluded. Verified South African form, not Philippine form.
